name: @aqua/cargo
description: Workspace-local Nx executor that wraps cargo for the Rust crates under crates/. Registered as '@aqua/cargo:run' in each crate's project.json. Lets `nx affected` and the Nx cache treat Rust crates as first-class projects, sharing the same task graph as TypeScript apps. Plan: docs/plans/sensor-rust-migration/PLAN.md (Faz 0 PR-A).
